Definition: probably from the base of G2360; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses thrēskós where it means religious, ceremonious in worship. In James 1:26, If any man among you seem to be religious.
TheologicalSignificance: A man who seems religious yet cannot bridle his tongue convicts me, because my own words give my worship away.
